IS 15840 : 2009 Determinaion of Volume of Wate and Water Level in Lakes and ReservoirsICS 17.120.20WRD 10Reaffirmed 20181 SCOPEThis standard deals with survey of the topography of lakes and reservoirs for the determination of volume of live storage and the determination of water level, the objective being to establish a relation between water level and volume. Conventional surveying methods and electronic distance measurement (EDM) and global positioning system (GPS), total station methods are included.2 REFERENCESThe standards given below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated below:1191: 2003 Hydrometric determinations — Vocabulary and symbols {second revision)14359 : 1996 Echo sounders for water depth measurements — Functional requirements15118 : 2002 Measurement of liquid flow in open channels — Water-level measuring devices15352 : 2003 Liquid flow measurement in open channels — Position fixing equipment for hydrometric boats
